deviations.to: subtype SYNTH carrying each slot's assessment objectives (AO2, AO3) and Bloom level (Apply)
deviations.why: the v0.2.0 learning-items schema has no DIAGRAM subtype; SYNTH is the schema's carrier of joined AO2/AO3 reasoning. The marking guidance still names every DIAGRAM answer part (axes labelled, original curves drawn and labelled, the shift or movement in the correct direction, new equilibrium marked and labelled, what the diagram shows in words), the answers are precise verbal walk-throughs of the diagram, and the prompts avoid the words chart and graph because this subject declares no chart model and C-35 and C-41 would otherwise demand a rendered depiction.
